hypotheses.U1_union16_improves_fisher8_mean_kl: The union of Frobenius rank eight and Fisher rank eight reduces mean exact KL by at least 20% versus Fisher rank eight on every corpus.
hypotheses.U2_union16_reaches_median_kl_gate: The rank-16 union has median exact KL at most 0.005 on every corpus.
hypotheses.U3_union16_preserves_native_scores: The rank-16 union has centered score R-squared at least 0.90 on every corpus.
hypotheses.U4_union16_preserves_task_ce: The rank-16 union increases mean next-token CE by at most 0.01 nats on every corpus.
hypotheses.U5_union16_reaches_top1_gate: The rank-16 union has native top-1 agreement at least 0.95 on every corpus.
hypotheses.U6_larger_union_has_diminishing_returns: Adding Frobenius axes 9 through 32 improves mean exact KL by less than 20% beyond union16 on every corpus.
